raw:
The task: sleep tracking app remark, displayed as one line under tonight's sleep numbers. Return only JSON {"remark":"..."}.

Today's data: time in bed 7h 50m, asleep 6h 20m, took 48 minutes to fall asleep, woke 3 times; user's goal is 7h asleep. Past 7 days average time to fall asleep: 15 minutes.

Key observations:
- Sleep duration 6h 20m vs goal 7h → 40 minutes short.
- Falling asleep took 48 min vs 7-day average 15 min → much longer than usual.
- Woke 3 times — could mention.

Rules: no apology, no exclamation, no "about/approximately", no "your/your", no mainland Chinese vocabulary, don't repeat obvious things, keep it short, don't explain how numbers are calculated, don't add disclaimers. This is a remark (one line), not a button/title, so no question-as-button concern, but keep tone neutral, not chatty.

Should the remark be encouraging or neutral? Apps like this typically show a brief insight. Something like: "Sleep duration is 40 minutes short of the goal; falling asleep took longer than the past 7-day average".

Avoid "your". Avoid "about". Avoid mainland vocabulary. Keep concise.

Options:

{"remark":"Sleep duration 40 minutes short of the goal; falling asleep took 33 minutes longer than the past 7-day average"}

That's factual. Or mention waking 3 times: "Falling asleep was slower, woke mid-sleep 3 times, sleep duration not yet at the goal". Hmm.

Best one line: "Sleep duration 40 minutes short of the goal; falling asleep took longer than the past 7-day average".

Or could offer a suggestion? Apps often give an insight + tip. But rules say don't exceed necessary length. Also no chatty phrasing. A neutral insight is safest.

Should we include the 3 awakenings? Perhaps: "Woke 3 times mid-sleep, falling asleep took longer than the past 7-day average, sleep duration not yet at the goal". That's a bit long. Two clauses might be better.

The most salient deviations: 48 min sleep latency vs 15 min average (big difference), and 40 min short of goal. Both worth noting.

Final: "Sleep duration 40 minutes short of the goal; falling asleep took longer than the past 7-day average"

Check mainland vocabulary: "time-in-bed", "fall asleep", "goal" fine. No "current", "data" (I used "average" fine), no "user". No "your/your". No exclamation. No "about". Numbers are exact (40, 33) — 7h50m asleep is 7:20... wait asleep 6h20m goal 7h → 40 min short. Correct. Sleep latency 48 vs 15 → 33 minutes longer. Correct.

Could compute percentages but no need.

Keep punctuation: semicolon okay. One line.

Final JSON.{"remark":"睡眠時間距離目標短 40 分鐘；入睡時間較過去 7 天平均多 33 分鐘"}

parsed.remark: 睡眠時間距離目標短 40 分鐘；入睡時間較過去 7 天平均多 33 分鐘
